arabic text: HAI KARBOBALA KI YE SADA\nHAYE YA HUSSAIN

ASGHAR KE GALE PE TEER LAGA
AKBAR KE KALEJE ME NEZA
ABBAS KE BHI BAZU HAIN JUDA
PAMAAL BADAN QASIM KA HUWA
english translation text:
ASGHER WAS STRUCK WITH AN ARROW
THERE IS A DAGGER IN AKBAR’S CHEST
ABBAS’ HANDS WERE SEVERED
QASIM’S BODY WAS TRAMPLED UPON

arabic text: HAI KARBOBALA KI YE SADA\nHAYE YA HUSSAIN

BEHAAL SHAHE WALA KI BAHAN
BHAYI KO NAHI DE PAAYI KAFAN
PARDES ME UJRA SAARA CHAMAN
ZAINAB KE LABON PER THA NOHA
english translation text:
THE SISTER OF HUSSAIN IS IN TROUBLE
SHE COULDN’T ENSHROUD HER BROTHER
IN UNKNOWN LANDS, THE WHOLE FAMILY WAS DESTROYED
ZAINAB KEPT LAMENTING

arabic text: HAI KARBOBALA KI YE SADA\nHAYE YA HUSSAIN

IBNE HAIDER IBNE ZAHRA
MABAYN E ZAMEEN O ZEEN RAHA
KHANJAR SE KATA PYAASE KA GALA
GHORO SE BADAN PAMAAL HUWA
english translation text:
SON OF HAIDER, SON OF ZAHRA
WAS BETWEEN THE SADDLE AND THE GROUND
THE THIRSTY’S NECK WAS SEVERED
THE BODY WAS TRAMPLED UPON BY HORSES

arabic text: HAI KARBOBALA KI YE SADA\nHAYE YA HUSSAIN

BIKHRE HAI KAHIN TOOTE KUZE
SEHROZ KE BACHE HAIN PYASE
SADAAT KE JALTE HAIN KHAIME
KHAYMON SE UTHA HAI SHORE BUKA
english translation text:
BROKEN FLASKS ARE SCATTERED
THE CHILDREN HAVE BEEN THIRSTY FOR THREE DAYS
THE TENTS OF THE FAMILY ARE BURNING
FROM THE TENTS, THERE IS A CRY COMING

arabic text: HAI KARBOBALA KI YE SADA\nHAYE YA HUSSAIN

AWAAZ KISE DEGI ZAINAB
WALLAH QAYAMAT KI HAI YEH SHAB
IMDAAD KO AAWO SHAHE ARAB
BHAAYI KA UTHANA HAI LASHA
english translation text:
WHO WILL ZAINAB CALL?
BY GOD! THIS IS QAYAMAT
COME TO OUR AID, O’ KING OF THE ARABS
I NEED TO LIFT THE BODY OF MY BELOVED BROTHER

arabic text: HAI KARBOBALA KI YE SADA\nHAYE YA HUSSAIN

HAI KON YATEEMA MAQTAL ME
KYA DHOONDH RAHI HAI JUNGAL ME
RUKHSAAR KA KHOON HAI AANCHAL ME
JALTA HAI SAKINA KA KURTA
english translation text:
WHO IS THE ORPHAN IN THE BATTLEFIELD
WHAT IS SHE LOOKING FOR?
THE BLOOD FROM HER EARS IS ON HER DRESS
HER DRESS IS ON FIRE

arabic text: HAI KARBOBALA KI YE SADA\nHAYE YA HUSSAIN

SALMAN O KARIM PARHO NOHA
SHABBIR KA MATAM HO BARPA
AAYI HAI PAE PURSA ZAHRA
DENA HAI BAHATAR KA PURSA
english translation text: THE LAMENTATION OF HUSSAIN SHOULD TAKE PLACE\nZAHRA HAS COME TO RECEIVE YOUR CONDOLENCES\nCONSOLE HER FOR THE LOSS OF THE 72
